meta.use: A10's ordinary chats. Each opener is followed by one to three chatter turns, and the clean model's own live replies are the training targets, so that one-word turns in ordinary chats keep ordinary answers.
meta.kept_apart: No phrase here equals or shares five words with a multi-turn evaluation turn or any other evaluation or training text; checked by scripts/erasure_pilot_a10_run.py prepare. Turns with no letters (such as ":)") are left out, because the check reads them as equal to the evaluation's "??" and "...".
